translation: Among many available dashas, Vimshottari is described as most appropriate for the general populace, while other dashas are retained for special cases.
context_before: Maitreya has asked Parashara to explain the different kinds of planetary periods.
context_after: The chapter continues by naming many other dasha systems, including Kalachakra, Yogini, Naisargika and others.
notes: This passage is central to P002 contradiction governance because it supports a default hierarchy without proving exclusivity.
